data.name: Chukwuma
data.gender_notes: Chukwuma is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chukwuma is a name of Igbo origin, meaning 'God's power'. It is a popular name among Christians in Nigeria. The name Chukwuma carries the meaning “God's power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Igbo. Parents who choose Chukwuma usually hope their child will grow to embody god's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reminding us of God's infinite power and strength.
data.etymology: Chukwuma belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chukwuma total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chukwuma reflects the strong cultural and religious influence of Christianity in Nigeria. The Igbo people, an ethnic group in Nigeria, have a rich cultural heritage that places a high value on personal names and their meanings. The name Chukwuma is a testament to the adoption and integration of Christian values into Igbo cultural practices. It portrays the belief in the power and sovereignty of God, and it serves as a reminder of the importance of faith in daily life.
data.spiritual_significance: As a name that signifies the power of God, Chukwuma carries great spiritual significance for its bearers. It embodies the belief that God is omnipotent and able to give strength and power to those who trust in Him. By bearing this name, a Christian can be reminded of their dependence on God for strength, guidance, and protection. It serves as a constant reminder of the divine presence in their lives and the importance of living a God-centered life. Additionally, the name Chukwuma can be a source of inspiration and encouragement for others, as it conveys a sense of faith, hope, and trust in God's power and abilities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chukwuma is a name of Igbo origin in Nigeria, meaning "God is the owner." It is a reminder that ultimate ownership and control belong to God, and that our lives are merely stewards in His divine plan.
